info.description: Unified STM collection ordered by 14 flows (docs/project-specification.md). NestJS {{baseUrl}}=http://localhost:3000/api/v1  FastAPI {{fastapiBaseUrl}}=http://localhost:8000/api/v1  WS {{wsBaseUrl}}=ws://localhost:8000/api/v1. Flow 5 is Celery-internal (no HTTP).
